old_value: {"id":"JMAP-a4gi","title":"chat-client *_query cannot send compound or metadata-02 filters","description":"Found during JMAP-1j9k.2. Every extension client /query and /queryChanges now takes Option\u003c\u0026jmap_types::query::Filter\u003cC\u003e\u003e (C: Serialize), and the chat *_query_changes methods do too. The chat *_query methods (chat_query, message_query, space_query, chat_contact_query, custom_emoji_query, plus Batch::chat_query_get / message_query_get) still build the filter by hand from *QueryInput fields (filter_kind, filter_muted, chat_id, ...), so callers cannot send RFC 8620 §5.5 AND/OR/NOT or draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02 §3.5 conditions, and /query cannot be sent the same filter that /queryChanges accepts (RFC 8620 §5.6). Fixing it changes the *QueryInput layout or moves chat to the positional shape, which is the open question in JMAP-ops7.20. Once ops7.20 is decided: give chat *_query a filter: Option\u003c\u0026Filter\u003cC\u003e\u003e (positional, or a field on the input struct) and add wire tests for a NOT operator and a WithMetadata leaf.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-10-20T03:15:45.00826881Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-10-20T03:15:45.00826881Z","dependencies":[{"issue_id":"JMAP-a4gi","depends_on_id":"JMAP-1j9k.2","type":"discovered-from","created_at":"2026-10-20T03:15:45.135292581Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"},{"issue_id":"JMAP-a4gi","depends_on_id":"JMAP-ops7.20","type":"blocks","created_at":"2026-10-20T03:15:45.236704686Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"}]}
